responsible.title: 1. Data Controller
responsible.text: Multiprecios Diego is the data controller of your personal data. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring your data is safe with us.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of Processing
purpose.text: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

list.1: Manage your orders, deliveries, and billing.
list.2: Handle your inquiries, doubts, or issues through our support.
list.3: Send you information about our products and offers if you have given us your express consent.

legitimation.title: 3. Legitimation
legitimation.text: The legal basis for processing your data is the execution of the purchase contract (when you place an order) and your explicit consent (for sending commercial communications or using cookies).

recipients.title: 4. Recipients
recipients.text: We will not transfer your data to third parties unless legally obliged or to providers strictly necessary for the service provision, such as transport and logistics companies to deliver your orders.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.text: As a user, you have the right to:

access.title: Access and Rectification
access.text: Consult your data and correct it if accurate.

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.text: Request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary.

rights.contact: To exercise these rights, write to us at

Their reproduction, distribution, public communication, and transformation without express authorization is prohibited.

liability.title: 3. Exclusion of Liability
liability.text: Multiprecios Diego is not responsible, in any case, for damages of any nature that may cause, by way of example: errors or omissions in the contents, lack of availability of the portal or the transmission of viruses or malicious or harmful programs in the contents, despite having adopted all necessary technological measures to avoid it.

object.title: 1. Object and Scope
object.text: These General Contracting Conditions regulate the commercial relationship between Multiprecios Diego and the user for the acquisition of products through this website. Acceptance of these conditions is an essential requirement to make any purchase.

prices.title: 2. Prices and Payments
prices.text1: The prices published on the web are in Euros (€) and include the Value Added Tax (VAT) applicable at all times.
prices.text2: Multiprecios Diego reserves the right to modify prices, articles, offers, and other commercial conditions without prior notice.

list.1: Shipments are made through urgent courier companies.
list.2: The usual delivery time is 24 to 72 working hours on the peninsula.
list.3: Shipping costs are automatically calculated before finalizing the order.

returns.title: 4. Returns and Warranty

withdrawal.title: Right of Withdrawal
withdrawal.text: You have a period of 14 calendar days from the receipt of the order to make returns without justification, provided the product is in perfect condition and in its original packaging.

returns.text: All our products have the mandatory legal guarantee of conformity. If you receive a defective product, we will take care of the repair, replacement, or refund at no cost to you.
